name: The Attack!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
After I put on Spybot's disguise, he'll head in to talk to Lescovar. The guards should let him pass no problem.

While you were getting materials for me, I took care of informing Marzon that it was time for him and Lescovar to meet again. I even dropped some false information.

Lescovar will dismiss his guards and wait for Marzon out here in the garden. After you catch wind of talk about the Defias, make your move. You need to kill them both before the guards return! When you're done, speak to Trias.
narrative.objectives: Remain in the garden until Lord Gregor Lescovar and Marzon the Silent Blade have had their conversation. Afterwards, kill them both before returning to Elling Trias in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText:
So it is done? Good. Thank you greatly for your discretion, adventurer. You've proven worthy on more than one count. I'll be sure to keep my eyes on you and your progress within the Alliance.

Be sure to keep your nose clean.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Yes, adventurer? Are things going well with Tyrion? He apprised me of the situation and I've helped him trick Marzon into going to the castle.

Marzon has been a thorn in the side of many people in Stormwind; many of which are close friends of mine. No one messes with my friends... not if they know what's healthy for them.

It's just a shame I'm indirectly doing a favor for Shaw and SI:7 in the meantime. Oh well, not every plan is perfect.

chain.subtitle: 12 quests from level 22 to 31, 16,290 XP in all.

quests.name: The Unsent Letter
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Letter to the City Architect to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

quests.name: Bazil Thredd
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Warden Thelwater in the Stockade.

quests.name: The Stockade Riots
quests.objectiveText: Kill Bazil Thredd and bring his head back to Warden Thelwater at the Stockade.

quests.name: The Curious Visitor
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

quests.name: Shadow of the Past
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

quests.name: Look to an Old Friend
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Elling Trias in Stormwind.

quests.name: Infiltrating the Castle
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Tyrion in Stormwind Castle.

quests.name: Items of Some Consequence
quests.objectiveText: Bring 3 Silk Cloth and 2 of Clara's Fresh Apples to Tyrion in Stormwind.

quests.name: The Attack!
quests.objectiveText: Remain in the garden until Lord Gregor Lescovar and Marzon the Silent Blade have had their conversation.

quests.name: The Head of the Beast
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

quests.name: Brotherhood's End
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

quests.name: An Audience with the King
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Baros Alexston's report on the Defias Brotherhood to King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.
